The Fender Pugilist Distortion pedal is a versatile stompbox that offers two separate distortion circuits which can be used individually or stacked for a more intense effect. This pedal features a sturdy metal construction and a compact design, making it suitable for use on pedalboards. The controls on the pedal include Level, Tone, Blend, and Gain knobs, allowing for a wide range of distortion tones to be achieved. The Fender Pugilist Distortion pedal is powered by a 9-volt battery or an optional AC adapter, providing flexibility in power options. The pedal also features true bypass switching, ensuring that the signal remains unaltered when the pedal is turned off. It is designed to be compatible with a variety of musical instruments, including electric guitars and bass guitars. The Fender Pugilist Distortion pedal is known for its ability to deliver a wide range of distortion tones, from subtle overdrive to aggressive heavy distortion. It is suitable for use in a variety of musical genres, from blues and rock to metal. The pedal is popular among guitarists seeking a versatile distortion pedal that can handle different playing styles and musical settings. Check if the Jewel Indicator is lit when the pedal is engaged. If it's not, ensure the pedal is connected to a power source via either a 9V battery or a compatible adapter. If you're using a battery, check the Low Battery Indicator to see if the battery needs replacing. 0 How can I get a richer tone with my Pugilist Distortion? Use the Blend/Series switch to adjust between parallel (Blend mode) or series distortion settings. Blending or stacking the two distortion engines can increase richness and complexity. You can also use the Bass Boost switch to add extra bass and lower-midrange energy. 0 Why is my battery running out quickly? Ensure that the LED Kill Switch is engaged to maximize battery life by turning off the LEDs. Check the Low Battery Indicator for when the battery is nearing its end.
